title: Execute dual input-block codebook row-group selector W4 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after deterministic candidate A/B identity, exact fresh-V7 reproduction, 169/169 V7-relative non-regression, strict aggregate fresh-V7 SSE improvement, 8/8 construction-blind non-evaluator exactness, 312 legal Dynamic Scale32 events, and complete hash verification produce PREATTEMPT_READY.json.

implementation_objective: Implement an isolated V9 runner and scalable backend that preserve V7 four-bit indices, per-output-row Scale32 records, and 128-input-lane blocks while adding two signed-Q4.4 codebook banks per block and one packed selector bit per frozen row group. Do not modify RTL, the live chat path, the sealed evidence, or Manager-owned stage state.

required_constructor.v7_initial_state: freshly reconstruct all 169 V7 tensors, duplicate each V7 input-block codebook into banks A and B, preserve V7 payload and row scales, set every selector to A, and prove byte-identical V7 reconstruction before V9 updates
required_constructor.dual_codebook: two strictly increasing sixteen-entry signed-Q4.4 int8 banks per contiguous 128 input lanes
required_constructor.selector: one bit per row group and input block; group size one for q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, and up_proj; group size two for down_proj; group size 32 for lm_head
required_constructor.selector_packing: row-group-major then input-block-major, least-significant-bit first, each tensor aligned to 16 bytes, all padding bits zero
required_constructor.bank_b_seed: optimize bank B from the upper half of row groups ranked by exact V7 block SSE, with decreasing SSE then increasing group ordinal tie order; keep selectors A until the first assignment
required_constructor.objective: exact unweighted BF16 source-space SSE for all 169 Linear tensors
required_constructor.determinism: independent candidate A/B payload, row-scale, dual-codebook, selector, reconstruction, objective, iteration-trace, weight, and state manifests match byte-for-byte
required_constructor.model_gate: all 169 tensors exactly reproduce fresh V7 before updates, none regress after updates, and aggregate unweighted BF16 SSE is strictly below 2303.224223882074

model_and_alias_policy.source_alias_assertion: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter and storage immediately after pinned-model load
model_and_alias_policy.split_operation: clone the complete embedding tensor into a detached non-trainable lm_head Parameter before construction and set only in-memory tie_word_embeddings false
model_and_alias_policy.embedding_preservation: original embedding object, storage, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 bytes remain unchanged
model_and_alias_policy.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linears plus separated lm_head

pre_attempt_artifact_set.preflight_failure_disposition: Preserve a hash-bound PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave attempt-0001 absent and unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the no-go to a Fresh Reviewer without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

acceptance_check: A Fresh Reviewer returns done after reproducing either a sealed marker-free PREATTEMPT_NO_GO with zero attempts consumed or a sealed single authorized attempt, and verifies exact V9 geometry, deterministic construction, fresh-V7 reproduction and model gate, 8/8 preflight quality, 312-event Dynamic Scale32 legality, and all bound hashes.
